plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-15 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). Program page states the pathways are for catalog year 2026-2027 and the map is headed 'Nutrition and Dietetics map for 2026-2027'. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. The program has ONE pathway, 'to CSU' (CSU Bakersfield), transcribed in full; there is no second pathway for this credential in the 2026-2027 mapper. The map prints the degree total as a range, 60-66 units, and term totals as 16-18.5 / 15-17.5 / 14-15 / 15. Ranged slots: Term 1 'Major List A' (4-5) and 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5); Term 2 'Major List A' (4-5) and 'Area 2 : Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning' (3-4.5); Term 3 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' (3-4). The Term 3 'Major List A' slot is printed at a fixed 5 units, unlike the ranged Major List A slots in Terms 1 and 2. Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged slot is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. The Term 1 'Major List A' slot, CHEM B1A and PSYC C1000 are each printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; the slot is recorded with category 'major' as a major-list choice slot and the two named courses are recorded with category 'major', all as printed. General-education, major-list and elective slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. The map prints a 'Prerequisites' flag (in Card View only) on CHEM B1A and BIOL B16 but does not print the specific prerequisite courses, so no prereqs are recorded. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
